memberPathBase: Explicit staged layout: cohort raw/ preserves original artifact-relative paths; snapshots/ preserves original workspace-relative paths below that declared prefix; validators/ and study-tooling/ preserve repository paths. archiveMetadata: gzip timestamp, tar ownership and file timestamps normalized; payload paths and contents preserved

manifestPlacement: External to archive so every archive member, without a self-hash exception, has a digest
